summaryZh: Sánchez 多尺度流动物理组研究工程与生物医学应用中的流体动力学问题，包括脑脊液流、反应流和振荡黏性流。团队结合渐近与摄动方法、数值模拟及小尺度实验。

evidence.quote: Skip to main content Multiscale Flow Physics Multiscale Flow Physics University of California, San Diego The research group of Antonio L. Sanchez Our research encompasses a wide variety of fluid dynamics problems emerging in engineering and biomedical applications. In investigating these flows, we often take advantage of the disparity of the length and time scales encountered in these complex problems to simplify the solutions, often by application of asymptotic methods that help to identify simpler sub-problems and serve to extract the fundamental underlying physics. These perturbation methods are supplemented by numerical simulations and small-scale laboratory experiments.
